proof_body:
by
  intro n
  have s3 : Real.sqrt 3 ^ 2 = 3 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have h1 : 1 < Real.sqrt 3 := by
    rw [Real.lt_sqrt (by norm_num)]; norm_num
  have h2 : Real.sqrt 3 < 2 := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_lt' (by norm_num)]; norm_num
  have key : ∀ k : ℕ, (∃ m : ℤ, (2 + Real.sqrt 3) ^ k + (2 - Real.sqrt 3) ^ k = 2 * m) ∧
      (∃ m : ℤ, (2 + Real.sqrt 3) ^ (k + 1) + (2 - Real.sqrt 3) ^ (k + 1) = 2 * m) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => exact ⟨⟨1, by norm_num⟩, ⟨2, by norm_num⟩⟩
    | succ k ih =>
      obtain ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩⟩ := ih
      refine ⟨⟨b, hb⟩, ⟨4 * b - a, ?_⟩⟩
      push_cast
      have e : (2 + Real.sqrt 3) ^ (k + 1 + 1) + (2 - Real.sqrt 3) ^ (k + 1 + 1)
          = 4 * ((2 + Real.sqrt 3) ^ (k + 1) + (2 - Real.sqrt 3) ^ (k + 1))
            - ((2 + Real.sqrt 3) ^ k + (2 - Real.sqrt 3) ^ k) := by
        have e1 : (2 + Real.sqrt 3) ^ 2 = 4 * (2 + Real.sqrt 3) - 1 := by nlinarith
        have e2 : (2 - Real.sqrt 3) ^ 2 = 4 * (2 - Real.sqrt 3) - 1 := by nlinarith
        calc _ = (2 + Real.sqrt 3) ^ k * (2 + Real.sqrt 3) ^ 2 + (2 - Real.sqrt 3) ^ k * (2 - Real.sqrt 3) ^ 2 := by ring
          _ = _ := by rw [e1, e2]; ring
      rw [e, hb, ha]; ring
  cases n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k =>
    obtain ⟨⟨m, hm⟩, _⟩ := key (k + 1)
    have hb0 : 0 < 2 - Real.sqrt 3 := by linarith
    have hb1 : 2 - Real.sqrt 3 < 1 := by linarith
    have hp0 : 0 < (2 - Real.sqrt 3) ^ (k + 1) := pow_pos hb0 _
    have hp1 : (2 - Real.sqrt 3) ^ (k + 1) < 1 := pow_lt_one₀ hb0.le hb1 (by omega)
    have hf : ⌊(2 + Real.sqrt 3) ^ (k + 1)⌋ = 2 * m - 1 := by
      rw [Int.floor_eq_iff]
      push_cast
      constructor <;> linarith
    rw [hf]
    exact ⟨m - 1, by ring⟩
